description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate report-progress. Adversarial cases discriminate it from siblings, especially report-state (single-project task status vs broad current-state snapshot), the hard routing boundary flagged in the 2026-05-31 review.
trigger_phrases: weekly progress report for the project
project status update with RAG and blockers
sprint report with completed and in-progress items
what's the status of project X
PM report with milestone tracker and next steps
punch list of completed and outstanding items
milestone report with target dates and RAG
project health check with owners and dates
how are we doing on the initiative this week
status report with risks, decisions, and next steps
adversarial_phrases: comprehensive state of the union for the whole platform
current-state snapshot with a health matrix across domains
write a strategic report with glossary and recommendations
intel brief with BLUF and confidence levels
get me up to speed on this topic quickly
notes: Adversarials route to siblings: broad current-state/health-matrix/state-of-the-union → report-state; strategic/glossary/recommendations → report-strategic; BLUF/confidence/get-up-to-speed → report-brief; PRD → plan-prd; architecture → arch-system (not a report). report-progress owns a single bounded project's task status — completed/in-progress/blockers/milestones/next-steps with owners and dates.
